title: Speed Queen — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Speed Queen.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Premium tier. Speed Queen makes laundry equipment that lasts a generation. The same machines in your laundromat — built on a commercial platform with metal components where others use plastic. Their top-load washer has a simple mechanical dial (no circuit board to fail), a stainless steel tub, and a 7-year warranty. The TC5 top-loader costs more upfront but when calculated per-year over a 25-year lifespan, it is the cheapest washer you can buy.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Lifetime buyers calculating cost-per-year. Customers who have had two or three washers fail in 10 years. Anyone who values simplicity and longevity over smart features.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Speed Queen:

• Commercial-grade build — same platform as laundromat machines, built to last 25 years

• 7-year warranty on the full machine — longest in residential laundry

• No circuit board on classic models — a mechanical timer cannot crash or need a software update

• Calculate cost-per-year: Speed Queen at $1,200 over 25 years = $48/year vs $800 washer over 7 years = $114/year

• Stainless steel tub, metal components, no plastic where it matters
